name: follow-builders-scripts
description: Scripts for Follow Builders skill – feed

scripts.build-html-digest: npm run prepare-digest | npm run build-digest | npm run render-html
scripts.push-feishu-local: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const { spawnSync }=require('child_process'); const htmlPath=path.join(process.cwd(), 'latest-digest.html'); const htmlLink=process.env.DIGEST_HTML_LINK || ''; const pushed=spawnSync(process.execPath, [path.join(process.cwd(), 'scripts/sendToFeishu.js'), '--file', htmlPath, '--html-link', htmlLink], {encoding:'utf8'}); if(pushed.status!==0){ process.stderr.write(pushed.stderr||'sendToFeishu failed\n'); process.exit(pushed.status||1); } process.stdout.write(pushed.stdout||'');"
